content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-32. - Official grade.

faqs.a:
(a)
All curbs, gutters and sidewalks constructed, reconstructed or repaired within the
               city, except as otherwise provided, shall be located and built upon the official grade
               of the city at the place where the same is to be constructed, reconstructed or repaired,
               as such grade is fixed or determined by the city engineer. If any curb, gutter and
               sidewalk constructed, reconstructed or repaired within the city is not to be laid
               and built upon the official grade, as then established, it shall be the duty of the
               person laying or building the same or causing the same to be laid and built, upon
               notice from the city engineer, to alter and reconstruct such sidewalk, curb or gutter
               so as to conform to the official grade within five days of such notice.
(b)
Where, in the opinion of the city engineer, it would not be practical or just and
               would not make for uniformity to have such curb, sidewalk and gutter reconstructed
               or repaired upon or according to the official grade, as then established, the city
               engineer may order or permit such sidewalk, curb and gutter to be reconstructed or
               repaired upon or according to the grade upon which such sidewalk or curb and gutter
               was formerly constructed and built.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
